# FuzzyRoutines

<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Timur Gilmullin and Fuzzy Technologies
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->

> Scalar fuzzy computing in Python. Published release: 2.0.0; supported CPython: 3.13 and 3.14. Pin the package and verify the installed version before execution. Development capabilities are not automatically released capabilities.

- [Agent entrypoint and versioned capability map](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/agent-quickstart/): canonical installation, computation, plots and JSON evidence.
- [Русский](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/ru/agent-quickstart/): запрос помощнику и объяснение результатов.
- [简体中文](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/zh-CN/agent-quickstart/): 智能体请求及结果解释。
- [API reference](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/api/): supported imports and contracts.
- [Historical Universal Fuzzy Scale](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/guides/universal-fuzzy-scale/): original coefficients, weak coverage and selection semantics.
- [Migration](https://fuzzy-technologies.github.io/FuzzyRoutines/api/latest/en/migration/1.0.3-to-2.0.0/): compatibility and corrected numerical behavior.
